defs: def stages: . as $d | [.config.graph_capabilities[] as $c | ($d.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == $c.target.task_id)) as $t | ($d.config.agents[] | select(.agent_id == $t.agent_id)) as $b | ($d.config.contexts[] | select(.context_id == $b.context_id)) as $x | {capability: $c, task: $t, tools: ($d.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $x.tools_id))}]; def stage($id): stages | map(select(.capability.capability_id == $id))[0]; def entries($id): .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == $id) | .entries.entries[]; def tool_names($id): [entries($id) | .tool_name]; def prompt($id): .config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == $id) | .prompt_template;

jq.name: the plan compiles to 4 nodes, 6 results and the research entry
jq.expr: (.assets["graphs/web_deep_research.plan.json"] | fromjson) | (.nodes | length) == 4 and (.results | length) == 6 and (.entries | map(.name)) == ["research"]

jq.name: no stage has host tools, memory, history, context budget, agents, self-config or defra queries
jq.expr: stages | length == 4 and all((.tools.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and (.tools.host.bash.mode // "Off") == "Off" and ((.tools.host.cli // []) | length == 0) and .tools.integrations.lsp == null and (.tools.built_ins.enable_memory // false) == false and (.tools.built_ins.enable_session_history_tool // false) == false and (.tools.built_ins.enable_context_budget // false) == false and (.tools.built_ins.enable_goal_creation // false) == false and (.tools.agents.enabled // false) == false and (.tools.self_config.enable_self_config // false) == false and (.tools.datastore.enable_defra_query // false) == false and .capability.workspace_authority == null)

jq.name: plan and investigate call only named remote tools of the one required service
jq.expr: ["research-plan", "research-investigate"] as $ids | . as $d | $ids | all(. as $id | $d | stage($id) | .tools.remote.services | length == 1 and .[0].mcp_service_id == "web-research-mcp" and .[0].required == true and (.[0].tool_names | length > 0 and all(contains("*") | not)))

jq.name: adjudicate and report have no remote tools
research-plan-writes grants exactly its datastore tools, each scoped to the run
jq.expr: tool_names("research-plan-writes") == ["write_research_assignment", "write_research_plan"] and ([entries("research-plan-writes")] | all((.filter_fields // .fields) | map(select(.name == "run_id")) | length == 1 and .[0].required == false and .[0].fill == "correlation"))

jq.name: research-investigate-writes grants exactly its datastore tools, each scoped to the run
jq.expr: tool_names("research-investigate-writes") == ["write_research_source", "write_research_claim", "write_research_evidence", "write_research_investigation"] and ([entries("research-investigate-writes")] | all((.filter_fields // .fields) | map(select(.name == "run_id")) | length == 1 and .[0].required == false and .[0].fill == "correlation"))

jq.name: research-adjudicate-io grants exactly its datastore tools, each scoped to the run
jq.expr: tool_names("research-adjudicate-io") == ["read_research_investigation", "read_research_source", "read_research_claim", "read_research_evidence", "write_research_claim_verdict", "write_research_draft"] and ([entries("research-adjudicate-io")] | all((.filter_fields // .fields) | map(select(.name == "run_id")) | length == 1 and .[0].required == false and .[0].fill == "correlation"))

jq.name: research-report-io grants exactly its datastore tools, each scoped to the run
jq.expr: tool_names("research-report-io") == ["read_report_research_source", "read_report_research_evidence", "read_report_claim_verdict", "write_research_result"] and ([entries("research-report-io")] | all((.filter_fields // .fields) | map(select(.name == "run_id")) | length == 1 and .[0].required == false and .[0].fill == "correlation"))

jq.name: each stage reads exactly its surface
typed carrier fields are interpolated into the stage prompts
jq.expr: . as $d | {"research-plan-task": ["question","scope","freshness","audience","output_requirements","investigator_count"], "research-investigate-task": ["assignment_id","question","lens","instructions","query_plan","source_requirements","freshness"], "research-report-task": ["title","thesis","outline","synthesis","unresolved_questions"]} | to_entries | all(. as $e | $e.value | all(. as $f | $d | prompt($e.key) | contains("{{ doc.\($f) }}")))

jq.name: adjudicate groups by correlation, not by group size
jq.expr: prompt("research-adjudicate-task") | contains("{{ group.correlation_value }}") and contains("{{ group.count }}") and (contains("event.group_size") | not)

jq.name: the investigator write minimums are enforced
evidence rows carry no fetch id or content hash field
the evidence schema keeps the fetch id and content hash out
evidence is typed fields, not a JSON blob
jq.expr: .assets | to_entries | map(select(.key | startswith("tests/") | not) | .value) | join("") | (contains("evidence_json") | not) and ([("verified_quote","quote_verified","evidence_id","source_id","fetch_id","content_hash","matched_query","retrieval_queries","search_engines","candidate_relevance_score","content_relevance_score","extraction_method","content_integrity_verified","evidence_shortfall","search_degradation","retrieval_failures","relationship","evidence_summary")] as $fields | . as $all | $fields | all(. as $f | $all | contains($f)))
